ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper part of the figure shows an H-O-N=O fragment, where O is connected to H and N, and N is also in a double-bond form with an O; the lower part shows a positively charged H2O-related oxygen and an N=O fragment. The curved arrow indicates that the oxygen in the upper nitrous acid/nitrite fragment forms a connection to the nitrogen below, while the protonated water oxygen part serves as a leaving/auxiliary part and does not belong to the final neutral nitrogen-oxygen skeleton. Reasoning: After migrating electrons according to the arrows, the retained neutral connected skeleton is that a terminal O is connected by a double bond to an N, this N is further connected through a bridging oxygen to another N, and the latter N is connected by a double bond to a terminal O, namely O=N-O-N=O. The corresponding SMILES notation of this structure is O=NON=O.

method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram and identify the atoms connected before the move: an H-O-N=O fragment and a lower N=O fragment associated with H2O+/oxygen. Follow the curved arrows: the oxygen of the nitrite/nitrous-acid fragment becomes bonded to the lower nitrogen, while the protonated oxygen part is not part of the neutral final nitrogen oxide skeleton. After relocating the electrons, write the remaining connected product as terminal O double-bonded to N, single-bonded through O to another N double-bonded to O. Encode that connectivity in SMILES: O=NON=O.

图像描述：图中上方显示一个 H-O-N=O 片段，O 与 H、N 相连，N 还与一个 O 成双键形式；下方显示一个带正电的 H2O 相关氧以及一个 N=O 片段。弯箭头表示上方亚硝酸/亚硝酸根片段中的氧向下方的氮形成连接，同时质子化的水氧部分作为离去/辅助部分，不属于最终中性氮氧骨架。
推理：按箭头迁移电子后，保留下来的中性连接骨架是端基 O 与一个 N 双键相连，该 N 再通过一个桥氧与另一个 N 相连，后一个 N 与端基 O 双键相连，即 O=N-O-N=O。该结构对应的 SMILES 写法为 O=NON=O。
